gameName: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring – Trick-Taking Game

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: The Fellowship of the Ring: Trick-Taking Game rulebook (via RulesPal)

steps.text: Your chapter card and the character cards it lists faceup in the center
A star token next to each character marked * on the chapter card
Shuffle the main deck; deal 1 faceup lost card by the chapter card (if it's the 1 of Rings, deal another and shuffle it back)
2 players: one extra 12-card hand becomes the pyramid - top row 3 (2 up, 1 down), middle 4 facedown, bottom 5 faceup; the 1 of Rings holder controls it
steps.note: If the pyramid has the 1 of Rings it is Frodo, controlled by the player to its right

steps.text: Set aside the 1 of Rings; deal the lost card; then 3 faceup hands of 4 and one of 3 + the 1 of Rings; the rest is a draw deck
Whoever has the 1 of Rings takes Frodo (side for {s}) and the Ring token, Cannot Lead Rings side up
From Frodo's left, each player picks a character; starred characters must be chosen; then remove the stars
From Frodo's left, resolve setup actions (exchanges pass 1 card facedown and get 1 back)
steps.note: Frodo may not exchange the 1 of Rings

steps.text: Solo: only 1 character's exchange per round
